record.rationale: Pure compiler binding for checked C/C++ assert predicates, shared by native-shaped configmgr and CPPU call sites. Relocates the existing CPPU Error boundary without adding another assertion owner, an injected configuration service, or a native SAL API. Exact conditions/evaluation order/diagnostic strings are preserved; original native process abort, NDEBUG mode, stack layout and post-abort recovery are not certified.
